scope: Frozen word-interface follow-up; distinct from receiver-recovery confirmation.

evidence_templates: Block {a} is painted {color} and is made of {material}.
The block called {a} has {color} paint over a {material} body.
Made of {material}, block {a} carries a {color} coat of paint.
Catalogue line for {a}: surface paint {color}; material {material}.
Block {a} was cast in {material} and then painted {color}.
On the shelf sits {a}, a {material} block with {color} paint.
Paint on block {a}: {color}. Material of block {a}: {material}.
{a} is a block; its paint is {color} and its material is {material}.
Inventory card {a}: a block of {material}, painted {color}.
The {color} paint on block {a} covers a body made of {material}.
query_templates: Which block has {color} surface paint and is made of {material}?
Which block is made of {material} and has {color} surface paint?
conjunction.world_change: Exchange one attribute between two objects sharing the other attribute; retain all four combinations.
conjunction.component_ambiguity: Each queried color and material independently matches exactly two objects in either world.
conjunction.sender: The existing four-object prompted Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct sender; questions and the counterworld are never supplied.
conjunction.primary_metric: All four answers correct: two questions in each of two worlds.
conjunction.intervals: Enclose separate 36-group and 12-template bootstrap intervals: 20,000 draws for each of three seeds.
